messages.subject: WITHOUT PREJUDICE - Hale and Wexford Holdings
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Ms Bartlett,

We act for Wexford Holdings Limited. Please see our without prejudice and subject to contract letter of today's date, sent by post and attached to a separate secure email, setting out proposed terms for a negotiated exit for Mr Hale. In summary the Company proposes a PILON of £92,500, accrued holiday of £7,115 and an ex gratia payment of £100,000, plus an agreed reference and a contribution to legal fees.

The offer is open until 5pm on 1 November. We'd be glad to discuss by telephone.

Kind regards,
Tom Gallagher
Associate

Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
T +44 (0)20 7946 0000
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
